name: dev-ba-kit
description: 64 skills for developers doing BA work: /discover (project intake → shared context brief consumed by every later skill) + discovery documents (/brainstorm→/urd→/brd→/prd-epic→/srs + product-level /prd and /roadmap) + specification (/usecase /userstory /ac /user-flow) + UI design (/wireframe-ascii /wireframe-html /prototype-html /figma) + 22 diagram skills (Mermaid/PlantUML/D2/BPMN/draw.io) + code-flow + scan-project + gallery + sync-confluence. Unified validate gates (diagram-validate + doc-validate). Two routers: /ba (documents) and /diagram (diagrams). Bilingual EN/VI. Scripts run as TypeScript via tsx.
